Presenting new Haryanvi hip hop 2025 – Matter by Sumit Parta & Panther
Bringing you the raw and fearless vibe of Haryana with "Matter", the latest fire track by Sumit Parta & Panther.
This song defines real street energy — filled with power, attitude, and pride. With intense lyrics, bold delivery, and unstoppable flow, Matter is all about dominance, loyalty, and living with no compromise.
If you believe in your hustle and never back down — this one’s for you.
